science_card_focus: Build one minimal source-grounded matched pair around normalized Lyapunov scaling over only the paper-supported Reynolds-number range Re in [50,1400], with public control Re and common dimensionless readout lambda(Re)/lambda(50). One private branch must use the source-reported DNS exponent alpha=0.59; a second branch may use alpha=0.5 only if the source explicitly presents that mean-field prediction as a competing quantitative law on the same normalized domain. Encode each as (Re/50)^alpha using only anchored numeric parameters. Do not require an unreported amplitude, do not extrapolate, and set case_authoring_ready=false if the source does not support both branches.
